instructions: This is a greenfield cross-platform TypeScript app (Node backend + browser Web UI) packaged with Tauri for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Do NOT suggest backward-compatibility shims, legacy fallbacks, or deprecation paths — update all call sites in the same change. Skip style/formatting nits. Focus on correctness, security, cross-platform behavior, and maintainability.

rules.rule: The Tauri shell hosts the window, menus, native pickers, and updater. Bundle loading, setup, and action logic belong in the TypeScript server. Flag misplaced logic.
Configuration display must redact keys, tokens, and secrets. Flag any code path that prints or logs raw credential-shaped values.
Code in app/shared must run in both Node and the browser. Disallow Node-only APIs (fs, path, process, child_process, os) — those belong in app/web/src/server only.
The Web UI is TypeScript compiled by tsc to vanilla ES modules with no bundler/framework. Flag introductions of bundlers, frameworks, or heavy runtime dependencies.
Every interactive control needs an accessible label (label/aria-label/title). Prefer semantic HTML over div soup.
Code must work on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Flag hard-coded path separators, POSIX-only shell commands, or platform assumptions without a platform branch.

Project is greenfield and unreleased. Reject suggestions to add backward-compatibility shims, legacy code paths, or deprecation warnings. Renames/restructures must update every call site in the same change.
